name: Glow words to footage card
what: Upright title sequence on a dark ground with a soft colour glow: a big word types on, slides off, and three small lines sharpen in one after another; then a round logo pops in, and a footage card of your video slams in and swings up into a tilted, frame-filling view.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f5-f38 the big word types on letter by letter; f34-f50 it slides out, speeding up, as line 2 pops up small and sharpens (f47-f62); f67-f85 line 2 slides out, line 3 blurs in (f82-f90); f100-f118 line 3 slides out, line 4 blurs in (f108-f118); f139-f147 line 4 shrinks away with the glow; f148-f158 the round logo pops in turning; f165-f173 it shrinks; f174-f185 the footage card slams in and settles; f187-f213 it swings up in perspective to fill the frame; then it holds to the end

tracks.name: glow
tracks.what: the colour glow grows from the left edge, then shrinks away

tracks.name: big word
tracks.what: the big word types on letter by letter, then slides left off the frame

tracks.name: line 2
tracks.what: pops up from 0.45 to full size, sharpening word by word, then slides left out

tracks.name: line 3
tracks.what: blurs in while drifting left, holds, then slides left out

tracks.name: line 4
tracks.what: blurs in while drifting left, then shrinks to half and fades with the glow

tracks.name: round logo
tracks.what: pops in 1.28 times too big and turned, settles, then shrinks away

tracks.name: footage card
tracks.what: slams in 1.45 times big and settles, then swings up in perspective to fill the frame, tilted

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the tilted card holds (the film grain moves)
